state.test: marks everything complete through its accessible label
state.history: 3 passed, 0 failed, 0 passed-on-retry out of 3 prior runs; 0 outcome flips; sequence oldest→newest: passed, passed, passed

cause.instructions: What is the most likely root cause of this CI test failure?

criteria.regression: The application under test changed behaviour: the test used to pass and now fails on a real functional difference, usually related to application code changed in this diff
criteria.flaky: The test is nondeterministic: a race, a timing-dependent wait or order dependence, so the same code sometimes passes and sometimes fails
criteria.environment: Infrastructure outside the code under test: network errors, a service or dependency down, DNS, runner resources, external timeouts
criteria.test-data: The test's own data is wrong: stale or edited fixtures, seed data missing or already consumed, expectations tied to data that changed

retryWouldPass.instructions: Would this test most likely pass if it were re-run on the same commit without any change?
